description: This file contains integration tests for loan prepayment amounts in the Fineract project. It defines multiple test cases that simulate loan disbursements, repayments, and validation of prepayment interest calculations.

classes.name: LoanPrepayAmountTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing loan prepayment amount calculations and behaviors in the Fineract system.

methods.name: testLoanPrepayAmountProgressive
methods.description: Tests the progressive prepayment amount calculation over multiple disbursements and dates.

methods.name: testLoanPrepayAmountProgressivePartialRepayment
methods.description: Tests the prepayment amount after partial loan repayment with interest recalculation enabled.

methods.name: testLoanPrepayAmountProgressivePartialRepaymentNoInterestRecalculation
methods.description: Tests the prepayment amount after partial loan repayment with interest recalculation disabled.
